title: vittetia orbiculata
intro: Vittetia orbiculata, commonly known as the "Round-leaved Vittetia," is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Vittetia orbiculata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
